Evidence Reviewed: SOC 2 Type II report section CC6; access control policy; SSO configuration guide
Key Finding: SSO and MFA supported. Privileged access to customer tenants is standing rather than just-in-time; no customer visibility of vendor admin activity.

Evidence Reviewed: DPA draft; encryption whitepaper; privacy policy; sub-processor list
Key Finding: Encryption at rest and in transit confirmed. No customer-managed keys. Personal data of Northstar customer contacts in scope with no documented lawful basis for the vendor's own processing.

Evidence Reviewed: Product documentation; model card (partial); LLM provider terms
Key Finding: Inference relies on a third-party LLM API. Vendor terms permit customer data to be used for model improvement unless opt-out is exercised in writing. No model card for the production configuration. No documented human review of consequential output.
Four sub-processors disclosed including the LLM provider and cloud host. List is not contractually pinned; vendor may substitute with 30 days notice and no approval right for Northstar.

Evidence Reviewed: BCP summary; SLA schedule; status page history
Key Finding: 99.9% SLA with credits. DR tested annually, last test evidenced. RTO of 8 hours exceeds Northstar's 4-hour tolerance for order-adjacent systems.
Documented IR process with defined severities. Contractual breach notification is 72 hours; Northstar's standard and regulatory position requires 24.

Evidence Reviewed: ISO 27001 certificate; SOC 2 Type II report; pen test summary
Key Finding: SOC 2 Type II held. Scope explicitly excludes the AI inference component. Last penetration test was 14 months ago against a 12-month policy.

Evidence Reviewed: Draft MSA; DPA draft; SLA schedule
